_metadata.description: Manifest-driven CLI surface: every command is a declared Connect-RPC binding, no programmatic shell layer.

requirements.title: Expose the full brand-manager command set via the manifest
requirements.description: The CLI declares create, list, get, update, delete, versions, assign, unassign, scenario-status, generate, discover, apply, and scan, each backed by a manifest-declared Connect-RPC binding.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at cli/manifest_test.go once the manifest-driven CLI is ported.

requirements.title: Every CLI command maps to an RPC with no programmatic shell
requirements.description: Each declared command resolves to exactly one served RPC method; there is no hand-rolled shell-out path, keeping the CLI a thin manifest-driven binding over the API.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at cli/bindings_test.go once the Connect-RPC bindings are ported.
